nuggets.text: The Monarchs have won seven straight games, tied with Utah for the third-longest winning streak in the country.
Ricky Rahne followed Hokies coach James Franklin from Kansas State to Vanderbilt to Penn State, where Rahne became offensive coordinator.
Ricky Rahne left Cornell as the Big Red's all-time leader in completions, passing yards and touchdown passes.
Quinn Henicle was named Cure Bowl MVP in just his second career start, sealing it with a 51-yard touchdown run.
Old Dominion dropped football after 1940 and revived it in 2009, going 9-2, the best modern record for a first-year program.
The Monarchs host the Oyster Bowl every year, a Shriners charity game whose history dates back to 1946.
The Monarchs' first-ever bowl game was the 2016 Bahamas Bowl, and they beat Eastern Michigan.
Quinn Henicle threw two touchdown passes and ran for two more in the Monarchs' 31-10 opening win over Norfolk State.
The Monarchs won 10 games last season for the first time since 2016.
The Monarchs won last year's meeting at Lane Stadium, 45-26.
